$comment: Limits of text slots that no visible box measures (read by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage/emdash-content-map.mjs into the content map). A number needs a real source: a box that was measured (how is said in `from`; Playwright, Chromium, 1440 / 768 / 390 px, on the live site of this theme, perf/slot-measure.mjs). A text no page draws in a box (an aria-label, a tooltip, a screen-reader-only word, a field the template never prints) has no number: it is declared `nonVisual` with where it is used, and the kit asks no limit of it.

limits.from: the site title is used only in the document `<title>` and `og:site_name` (Base.astro `siteTitle`) and as the logo's alt text when neither the logo nor the business name has one (brand.ts): no page draws it in a box and the setting declares no maxLength (the business name the header prints is its own slot, chrome.brand_name, which is measured)

the business name is printed as the logo lockup in the header (Header.astro, `.mg-logo`, shown when the customer has no logo picture); filled with Latin running text until the lockup gains a row beyond today's one row (Playwright, Chromium, 1440 / 768 / 390 px, the live site of this package (perf/slot-measure.mjs)): 59 characters at 1440 px, 62 at 768 px, 24 at 390 px
the word before the author's name in the post meta line (PostMeta.astro) sits in a `mg-sr` span, visible to screen readers only: no box draws it, so no box limits it

the whole copyright line is one paragraph in the footer (Footer.astro, the template with {year} and {name} filled in); filled with Latin running text in the name until the line gains a row beyond today's one row (Playwright, Chromium, 1440 / 768 / 390 px, the live site of this package (perf/slot-measure.mjs)): name of 187 characters at 1440 px, 93 at 768 px, 25 at 390 px, that is a 64-character line at 390 px with the 39 characters around the name
